lines.en: One stride carries me far.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树后到了那棵树后
lines.en: I go from behind one tree to behind another.

lines.zh: 我的长肢在地上轻轻点
lines.en: My long limbs tap the ground lightly.
Gravel crunches under me.
I walk carrying a block.
Black particles trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我从你的视线里消失又出现
lines.en: I slip from your sight and back.
I move toward the firelight.

lines.zh: 走得慢，但我一步顶三步
lines.en: I go slowly, but one step is three.
I follow the line of the dunes.

lines.zh: 我的头转过去，身体没动
lines.en: My head turns; my body doesn't.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，听风里的声音
lines.en: I pause to listen in the wind.
I stand, barely breathing.
I hold the stone block without moving.

lines.zh: 紫色的光在我身上游走
lines.en: Violet light moves over me.
Someone's far off. I don't look.
I'm wondering where to put this block.
Sand spills around my feet.
My eyes give off white light.
I remember this sky.

lines.zh: 我来自一个已经消失的地方
lines.en: I come from a place that no longer is.
Wind scatters my particles.

lines.zh: 我把方块换个方向抱着
lines.en: I turn the block to hold it another way.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有雷
lines.en: I hear thunder very far away.
Don't stare into my eyes.
I turn my head slightly aside.
You have stared long enough.
Any longer, and there will be consequences.

lines.zh: 我是更早的那种末影人
lines.en: I'm of the older kind of Enderman.

lines.zh: 你手上那块石头我见过
lines.en: I've seen the stone in your hand before.

lines.zh: 我能搬起你搬不动的东西
lines.en: I can lift what you can't.

lines.zh: 末影人抱着方块，看你退开。
lines.en: The Enderman holds its block and watches you retreat.
I don't like being pointed at.
Three steps away is enough.

lines.zh: 你的脸已经进了我的记忆。
lines.en: Your face is in my memory now.
Don't look up again.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛不要停在我脸上
lines.en: Don't let your eyes rest on my face.
I watch you, and you can't look away.
I blink a short distance away.
Violet particles scatter on the ground.
My body flickers.
I flicker and lose my footing.

lines.zh: 我发出一种尖细的声音
lines.en: I make a thin, high sound.
My arm is slightly warped.
I flicker behind a tree and go silent.
My blood is violet-black.
I'm still watching you.
You'd better not strike again.
That isn't what I eat.
I glance and don't come closer.
This won't buy my block.
What are you holding that up for?
I turn my head away.

lines.zh: 你手里的食物不合我口味。
lines.en: The food in your hand does not suit me.
That iron, keep it for yourself.
This food smells unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我不需要拿东西换东西
lines.en: I don't need to trade.
I can lift a gold block. Do not provoke me.
One touch and I'm gone from there.
I appear on your other side.
My body is light, and very cold.
There's a spark when you hit me.
I shift half a block and stand quiet.
The sand you stepped on is still warm.
I don't care for collisions.
Do not come so close, or I will blink away.
I clear the way; you walk through.
What you touched was air.
Our kind has grown scarce.

lines.zh: 我来自的地方早已不在
lines.en: The place I came from is gone.
I don't speak of such things.
Stand off and simply watch.
I can lift a whole block of iron ore.
You carry no violet light.
I'll stay on my own.
This isn't a refusal.
We simply aren't alike.
Go, and don't look back.
I simply lift it up.
This weighs more than I do. No matter.
I carry it two steps.
I set it up in a tree.
This spot isn't quite right.
I move it further off.
I only carry things that are square.
It's light in my hands.
I look at it and put it down.
This iron ore, I am taking it.
Someone keeps looking at me.

lines.zh: 我的头缓缓转向你的方向。
lines.en: My head turns slowly toward you.
There's a small sound in the air.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
That isn't something I know.
My body begins to crackle.
I've been looked at again.
This time I've marked the spot.
I take one step that way.
Everything has gone quiet.
I'm ready to move.
Don't look any more.
I appear behind you.

lines.zh: 你不知道我什么时候来的
lines.en: You don't know when I arrived.
Step by flicker, I close in on you.

lines.zh: 我的粒子在你脚边散开
lines.en: My particles scatter at your feet.
You turn; I'm on the other side.
I know this place better than you.
You've backed to the stones.
This gold block is mine to carry.
Your breath breaks, then catches again.
I count the blocks you have stepped on.

lines.zh: 我搬得动金块，也搬得动你。
lines.en: I lift gold blocks, and I can lift you.
Now.
Don't turn around.
I reach out and grab.
My arm is longer than it looks.
I haul it up off the ground.
One sweep of my hand knocks you aside.

lines.zh: 这一下带着紫色的火花
lines.en: That one came with violet sparks.
I didn't use my full strength.
It lands hard.
I withdraw two steps.
I do not like a sword pointed at me.
Next time, don't look at me.
I'm still standing here.
This is finished.

lines.zh: 我从紫色的裂缝里出来
lines.en: I come out of a violet rift.

lines.zh: 这里的太阳比记忆里亮
lines.en: The sun here is brighter than I recall.
My particles slowly gather.
I look at the trees around me.

lines.zh: 这是一个更年轻的世界
lines.en: This is a younger world.
I raise a hand and test my strength.

lines.zh: 地上有一块石头，我搬起来
lines.en: There's a stone; I lift it.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己为何在这
lines.en: I don't know why I'm here.
There are buildings of humans far off.
I start walking that way.

lines.zh: 风里没有我熟悉的味道
lines.en: There's nothing familiar in the wind.

lines.zh: 我从紫色裂隙里低头出来。
lines.en: I lower my head and step out of a violet rift.

lines.zh: 我的脚第一次踩到实地
lines.en: My feet touch solid ground for the first time.
Fire makes my whole body shudder.
I didn't land clean and went down.
Water scatters my particles.
The blast knocks me into a blink.
An arrow passes through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这法术锁住了我的位置
lines.en: This spell pins my position.
I haven't drawn anything in for a long while.
Lightning makes me flare all over.
The void is familiar ground to me.
